thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: node/gpu-node-14 reporting DiskPressure -> multiple modelcache pods evicted (cluster: prod-us-west-1)
Priya: seeing repeated pod evictions and runtime restarts. ran `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep modelcache` and several are CrashLoopBackOff.
Sam: oncall here, looking. any customer-facing 5xxs?
Priya: yes: alerting shows increased 503s for /generate on dedicated-tenant-12. top traces show token latency spikes then `CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS` in runtime logs before pod restart.
Alex: attaching snippet from runtime log: ```
[2024-06-] runtime] ERROR: failed to allocate kv-cache, cudaMalloc returned CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/srv/runtime/serve.py", line 412, in generate
    kv = cuda.alloc(cache_size)
RuntimeError: CUDA OOM
```
Marta: that looks like model cache eviction + disk pressure cascading into GPU OOMs when the runtime tries to reload model shards. Node disk usage on /var/lib/modelcache is at 99%.
Sam: can we confirm which process is filling disk? `ssh gpu-node-14 sudo du -sh /var/lib/* | sort -h`?
Priya: ran du, largest dirs: `/var/lib/modelcache` (1.6T), `/var/log/serve` (220G), `/var/lib/docker` (140G). modelcache old versions piled up.
Sam: immediate mitigation options: 1) cordon+drain node and move pods 2) delete old modelcache versions on node 3) scale down modelcache prefetch to avoid re-populating 4) temporary routing to smaller variant. Which do we want first?
Alex: cordon+drain to stop new pods landing, then clean modelcache version directories, restart kubelet and let pods reschedule. but draining may pressure other nodes.
Marta: we can also set autoscaler to avoid scheduling heavy inference pods to remaining nodes while we clean.
Sam: ok I'll take node cordon + partial drain. Priya, can you prepare the cleanup script? I'll coordinate the drain.
Priya: prepping script now. will remove modelcache older than 7 days and truncate rotated logs. script: ```
ssh gpu-node-14 sudo bash -c '
find /var/lib/modelcache -maxdepth 1 -mtime +7 -type d -exec rm -rf {} +
find /var/log/serve -name "*.log.*" -type f -delete
'
```
Priya: also plan to clear /tmp/modelcache-temp and restart model-cache sidecar: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/model-cache -n inference --field-selector=spec.nodeName=gpu-node-14`
eng-pager: tagging oncall rotation, Sam you own the pager until handoff. @Alex please standby for runtime kernel tweaks if restarts don't help.
Sam: cordoning node now: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-14` -> `node/gpu-node-14 cordoned`
Sam: draining non-critical pods: `kubectl drain gpu-node-14 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force` -> some pods evicted, modelcache pods terminated and restarted elsewhere but hitting OOM on restart (due to cache repop).
Priya: running cleanup script now. deleting old versions ~1.1T freed so far. truncating logs freed +180G.
Priya: after cleanup df -h shows /var/lib at 45% used.
Alex: restarting kubelet to settle resource accounting: `systemctl restart kubelet` -> kubelet back online.
Marta: policy tweak: lowered modelcache prefetch concurrency on the cluster config (temporarily set PREFETCH_CONCURRENCY=1) to avoid stampede.
Sam: monitoring metrics: request 5xxs dropped from 12% -> 3% after cleanup and drains. tail logs show fewer CUDA OOMs.
Priya: also scaled down heavy tenants on Dedicated-12 by swapping route to model-variant-small for 10 minutes (feature flag rollback).
eng-pager: customer-impact note: Dedicated-tenant-12 experienced degraded latency and some 503s for ~25 minutes, tickets being opened for affected customers. please add details to incident page.
Alex: followup: we should add an eviction-protection quota on /var/lib/modelcache and implement automatic GC for stale model versions. filing a ticket: INF-3246.
Marta: also recommend adding node-level alert that triggers at 80% ephemeral disk used to warn earlier. INF-3247.
Sam: what's the status? can we uncordon?
Priya: nodes healthy, modelcache pods stable on other nodes, no OOMs in last 10m. I'll leave gpu-node-14 cordoned for now for deeper cleanup, but we can resume scheduling in 30m.
Sam: thanks all. I'll do the handoff to next oncall at 1718505600. leave any postmortem notes here.
Priya: note for postmortem: root cause is unbounded modelcache version retention combined with rotated-log retention policy and a model prefetch stampede on restart that caused rehydration to hit both disk and GPU memory limits. mitigation: GC, prefetch throttling, cordon+drain, temp variant routing.
eng-pager: handoff: @Marta you are primary for followups, @Alex will own kernel/runtime followups, @Priya will own cleanup automation.
Marta: will open postmortem and link to bug tickets. thanks team. :white_check_mark:
Sam: resolved for now, monitoring the cluster for 2 hours.
